Ага.translation: My older brother is a teacher.

Байке.translation: My older brother is a driver, my older sister is a seamstress.

Ини.translation: My younger brother is a student.

Карындаш.translation: My older brother is a driver, my younger sister is a pupil.

Синди.translation: My younger sister goes to kindergarten.

Жезде.translation: My older sister is an engineer, my brother-in-law is a linguist.

Жеңе.translation: My older brother and his wife are teachers.

Күйө.translation: My daughter's husband is a doctor.

Күйөө.translation: My husband works at a factory.

Тайата.translation: John's maternal grandfather works at a firm.

Тайаке.translation: My maternal uncle lives in Bishkek.

Тайэже.translation: My maternal aunt is a singer.

Чоң ата.text: Чоң атам менен чоң апам айылда жашайт.
Чоң ата.translation: My grandfather and grandmother live in the village.

Дос.translation: I am going to the bazaar with my friend.

Ынтымактуу.text: Ооба, менин үй-бүлөм чоң жана ынтымактуу.
Ынтымактуу.translation: Yes, my family is big and close-knit.

Айдоочу.translation: My older brother is not a student, he is a driver.

Жазуучу.translation: My father is a writer, my mother is a singer.

Ырчы.translation: My mother is a singer, she sings well.

Кызматчы.translation: My father is an office worker, my mother is a shopkeeper.

Дүкөнчү.translation: A shopkeeper works in a shop.

Мугалим.translation: Who is this? — This is a teacher.

Окуучу.translation: I am a pupil, I study at school.

Белгилүү.translation: My maternal uncle is a well-known writer.

Пенсияда.translation: No, they do not work, they are retired.

үч.text: Үч литри алтымыш беш сом турат.

жети.translation: I get up at seven o'clock.

тогуз.translation: Asan got up at nine o'clock.

отуз.translation: My older brother is thirty years old.

алтымыш.text: Үч литрин алтымыш беш сомго бересизби?
алтымыш.translation: Will you give me three litres of it for sixty-five som?

жетимиш.translation: All right, I will give it for seventy som!

сексен.translation: My grandfather is eighty years old.

жүз.text: Мага жүз америкалык долларды алмаштырып бериңиз.
жүз.translation: Please change a hundred American dollars for me.

миң.text: Бир айда бир жарым миң сом алам.
миң.translation: I earn one and a half thousand som a month.
